mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCHING_TBL VALUES (SEQ_MATCH_NO.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, #{matchingTitle}, #{matchingContent}, DEFAULT, NULL, DEFAULT, #{matchingLocation}, NULL, NULL, #{matchingTime}, #{partnerType}, #{matchingType}, #{matchingUserCount}, NULL, #{matchingPrice}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{locationUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT M.MATCHING_NO, M.MATCHING_TITLE, M.MATCHING_CONTENT, TO_CHAR(M.MATCHING_PRICE, '999,999,999') AS MATCHINGPRICE, M.MATCHING_LOCATION, M.MATCHING_TIME, M.PARTNER_TYPE, M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT, M.CREATED_AT, U.USER_NAME, PER.CAREER, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_APPLI_TBL AT WHERE AT.MATCHING_NO = M.MATCHING_NO) AS applicationCount FROM MATCHING_TBL M JOIN USER_TBL U ON M.USER_NO = U.USER_NO JOIN REQUEST_PERMISSION PER ON M.USER_NO = PER.USER_NO WHERE M.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND M.MATCHING_TYPE = 'TRAINER' ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT M.MATCHING_NO, M.MATCHING_TITLE, M.MATCHING_CONTENT, M.MATCHING_LOCATION, M.MATCHING_TIME, M.USER_NO, M.CREATED_AT, M.PARTNER_TYPE, M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT, M.MATCHING_PRICE, M.LONGITUDE, M.LATITUDE, M.LOCATION_URL, U.USER_NAME, PER.CAREER, PER.CAREER_DETAIL FROM MATCHING_TBL M JOIN USER_TBL U ON M.USER_NO = U.USER_NO JOIN REQUEST_PERMISSION PER ON M.USER_NO = PER.USER_NO WHERE M.DELETE_YN = 'N' AND M.MATCHING_TYPE = 'TRAINER' AND M.MATCHING_NO = #{matchingNo}
